name: PB08 Heavy Blaster Pistol
description: Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.'s PB08 Heavy Blaster Pistol was one of the most sturdy and reliable blaster pistols on the market. It featured a short ventilated barrel and a heat management system. The internal gas was circulated in heat sinks in the barrel, causing a unique energy management that economized the tibanna stores. It cost 800 credits.
